response.overview: In this thrilling sequel, the Queens find themselves hiding out in the picturesque St. Thomas, Virgin Islands, after escaping the U.S. with stolen jewels. Seeking refuge with Audra's family, they plan to lay low, but things spiral out of control when Audra's showy cousin, Chico, brings unwanted attention. The group is robbed, and when Sam retaliates, she accidentally shoots the thief-who belongs to a dangerous local family. Now the Queens face a deadly ultimatum: pay $2 million or steal a priceless ceremonial mask tied to the island's cultural history. As they strategize the heist, their old nemesis Trip tracks them down, demanding his cut of the loot, turning their St. Thomas escape into a tense showdown.
response.title: Scheme Queens 2
